Date ____ April 13, 19 38.

Subject (in full) ____ Hugh Alexander KEAYS - changes title of his firm.

Made by ____ and ____ Forwarded by ____ Inspector Papp.

Enquiries indicate that H.A. KEAYS has recently
changed the name of his firm - The Oriental Navigation and
Transportation Company - into "Keays & Co." but continues to
occupy the same office in the Bank of East Asia Building,
5th Floor. Vladimir Alexandrovich KYBALKOFF, C.R.O. F-2112,
appears to be friendly with Keays at present. Other
frequent callers at his office are Pick and Max Gurevich.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C.S.6, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：S.M.P. SPECIAL POLICE REGISTRY File No. S. P. 8326 8/11/37）
Date November 5 1937

Subject H. A. KEAYS, - movements of.

Made by D.S. Mischenko. Forwarded by N. Medvedeff, D.S.I.

Hugh A. KEAYS, a person of doubtful repute, who is
well known among local radio and motor car dealers for his
intimidatory methods in obtaining possession of goods
purchased on the "hire-purchase" system and for which payment
invariably remains in arrears, is now residing at House No.
44-46, Lane 41, Carter Road.

KEAYS, a tall blond, 40 years of age, was formerly
in the United States Navy, and after taking his discharge
in Shanghai become associated with the firm of Messrs.
Anderson & Meyer.

On April 12, 1922 whilst he was employed by the
" Oriental Detective Agency " he was arrested by the French
Police on suspicion of having been concerned with other
persons in the attempted extortion of $ 2000.00 from a
Chinese opium dealer ( C.I.D.Reg. Files No. 6824 and 7128/22).
At the time of his arrest, a letter addressed to him from
the notorious Widler was found in his possession. This
letter showed that KEAYS was definitely connected with an
organized gang of persons trafficking in narcotics.

It is also known that he is an associate of *NAIDIS
who was accused in the WALDEN case.

According to information received, KEAYS is at present
working for Japanese interests and is being well REMUNERATED
for his services.

日期 1937年11月5日

事由 H. A. KEAYS, - 行踪。

制作人 D.S. Mischenko。转呈人 N. Medvedeff, D.S.I.

Hugh A. KEAYS，一名声誉可疑之人，在当地无线电和汽车经销商中广为人知，因其通过恐吓手段获取以“分期付款”方式购买但始终拖欠货款的商品所有权，现居住在卡德路41弄44-46号。

KEAYS，金发高个子，40岁，曾在美国海军服役，在上海退伍后与 Anderson & Meyer 公司发生关联。

1922年4月12日，当他受雇于“东方侦探社”时，因涉嫌与其他人员合谋企图向一名中国鸦片商贩勒索2000.00美元而被法国警察逮捕（刑事侦缉处注册档案编号 6824 和 7128/22）。被捕时，在他身上发现了一封臭名昭著的 Widler 写给他的信。该信表明 KEAYS 确实与一个有组织的贩毒团伙有关联。

另悉，他是 *NAIDIS 的同伙，后者在 WALDEN 案中被指控。

据收到的消息，KEAYS 目前为日本利益集团工作，并因其服务获得丰厚的报酬。
